segments.text: Miljovich. Yes, that Miljovich just open sourced an AI memory system and it's topping the benchmarks. Memphalis organizes AI memory into spatial
geometries inspired by the ancient Greek method of lossi wings, halls, and rooms instead of a messy vector database. A
custom compression algorithm called AK condenses months of conversations into a tiny token footprint without losing semantic
